name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Hologram Suncatcher And Hanging Charms
description:
KEY FEATURES

 

  • Premium Material:

  - Made from premium acrylic material, providing durability and a vibrant stained-glass style appearance.

  - Acrylic thickness: 3mm, lightweight yet sturdy for long-term use.

  - Available in two unique acrylic effects:

      +) Starburst Acrylic – creates a radiant light reflection effect similar to stained glass.

      +) Broken Glass Acrylic – produces sparkling reflections with a textured glass-like look.

 - Includes metal hanging chains (black or silver) for securely attaching the charms.

Comes with a strong suction cup hook for easy hanging on windows, walls, or smooth surfaces.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

Main Sign Size Options:

    +) 4 x 4 in ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm.

    +) 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm.

   +) 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm.

   +) 10 x 10 in ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm.

   +) 12 x 12 in ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm.

Minimum charm size: 1.18 in ~ 3 cm.

Available in 1-tier or 2-tier charm layouts depending on the design.
📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:

 - High-quality UV printing technology ensures vivid colors and detailed artwork.

 - Supports 1-sided printing only, with the design printed on the front side.

 - When printed on both sides, the back side will appear mirrored to maintain correct viewing from both directions.

 - The holographic acrylic surface enhances light reflection, creating a beautiful stained-glass visual effect when sunlight passes through.

 

  • Functional & Usage:

 - Decorative window suncatcher or hanging ornament that captures sunlight and creates colorful reflections.

- Ideal for decorating windows, living rooms, bedrooms, gardens, balconies, or workspaces.

 - Hanging charms add a dynamic and personalized decorative element that gently moves with airflow.

 - Lightweight and easy to install using the included suction cup hook and metal chains.

 - Can be used as a personalized decorative sign, family keepsake, or meaningful display piece.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

 - A thoughtful personalized gift for family members, friends, or loved ones.

 - Perfect for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, and special celebrations.

 - Ideal for people who enjoy meaningful décor, stained-glass style ornaments, and personalized keepsakes.

 - Adds a unique artistic touch to homes, offices, or personal spaces.

A beautiful decorative piece that combines personalization, creativity, and vibrant light-catching design 🎁

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
